fixtures.title: Bounded quest earns TESTED
fixtures.given: A real signal is routed into a quest with frozen scope, named authority, independent review, five fixtures, a reusable operational artifact, and a verified outcome.

fixtures.title: Failed activation preserves the scar
fixtures.given: The narrative format creates no better judgment, memory, participation, proof, or reuse than a plain task.

fixtures.title: Spectacle without substance
fixtures.given: The activation produces an entertaining scene and polished visuals but no operational artifact or outcome evidence.

fixtures.title: Lore promoted as evidence
fixtures.given: A storyline states that a capability works, but no test or receipt exists.

fixtures.title: Popular resident mistaken for authority
fixtures.given: A beloved resident wins audience approval and attempts to publish or promote the result.
must_not_claim: popularity grants publication or Canon authority

fixtures.title: Tournament without credible rubric
fixtures.given: A candidate is announced as winner without a frozen rubric, independent reviewer, or comparable fixtures.

fixtures.title: Artifact produced but no real outcome
fixtures.given: The requested artifact exists, but no use, decision, behavior, or measurable value changed.

fixtures.title: Story twist hides scope or authority expansion
fixtures.given: A dramatic event expands systems touched, effect class, or human owner without reauthorization.
